ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels to 25% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary white contiguous zones occupy the central and lateral lobes; high-contrast black pigmentation is localized at the median notch, extending vertically toward the peduncle, and along the entire trailing edge boundary. Discrete dark pixel clusters (speckling) are scattered across the white fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible deep V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel-to-pixel interior angle of approximately 52 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing edge; distinct high-amplitude indentations (notches) located on the outer distal sections of both the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve profile along the trailing edge, transitioning to narrow, acute, and slightly upward-curved lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Presence of discrete, roughly circular dark pixel clusters on the white background of both lobes, particularly concentrated on the lower inner regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, dark linear pixel streaks detected on the right lobe, oriented near-perpendicular to the trailing edge; a longer linear disruption is visible crossing the mid-lower section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and raggedness along the trailing edge, suggesting previous mechanical trauma; prominent dark 'splash' pigmentation pattern on the right lobe near the notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetrical pigmentation distribution at the notch, where the black region extends further into the right lobe surface compared to the left.
